description.value: A large-format Walmart Supercentre located on Scott Road in Delta, offering a full grocery section alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, and baby products. As one of the largest retail stores in the area, it provides comprehensive resupply options for touring cyclists passing through the South Surrey/Delta corridor. The store was verified open as recently as May 2026.
